scientific_integrity: Proof supplies global upper bounds and nonzero tail asymptotics; numerical computations support constants but are not an infinite-dimensional proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classical arithmetic mean and classical Aluthge iterates of the positive two-isometric unilateral weighted-shift family only; positive fixed parameter c. No uniform-in-c theorem or extensions to other means; historical priority subject to specialized unindexed work.
title: Fourth-order Schatten cancellation between mean and Aluthge iterations of two-isometric shifts
